text: A nude female with long, flowing red hair, pale skin, and glowing orange eyes. She reclines on a stone floor atop a glowing red pentagram. Her body is slender yet curvaceous. She wears only a blue choker and a sheer white cloth draped over one shoulder. One hand rests near her hip; the other supports her weight against a wall. Her gaze is direct, intense. Background shows dimly lit, rustic stone walls with vases and candles.
